name: prism-player
description: Prism: a foobar2000-style music player whose colours follow the album art. Cue sheets, music DJ with auto-mix, Last.fm play counts and recap summary, two solid looks, up to six resizable visualisers, synced lyrics, gapless playback, 10-band EQ, ReplayGain, WASAPI exclusive output, smart caching, customizable hotkeys.
author: Prism
